create_SageAttentionBackend: create a SageAttentionBackend instance to provide attention backend configuration for sage attention
get_supported_head_sizes: get the list of supported head sizes for SageAttentionBackend including 32 through 256
get_SageAttentionImpl: get the SageAttentionImpl class returned by SageAttentionBackend.get_impl_cls for attention implementation
build_SageAttentionImpl: build a SageAttentionImpl with num_heads, head_size, causal flag, and softmax_scale for attention computation
run_SageAttentionImpl_forward: run the forward method of SageAttentionImpl with query, key, value tensors and attention metadata
